why_choose_us.title: We call you back
why_choose_us.description: The most common complaint homeowners have about roofers is that nobody answers and nobody returns the message. We answer, we quote when we said we would, and we start when we said we would. Our customers say so in their own words.

why_choose_us.title: Owens Corning Preferred Contractor
why_choose_us.description: Manufacturer certification is what backs the longest warranty available on your roof. It is also the credential that outlasts us — coverage tied to Owens Corning rather than to any contractor still being in business in fifteen years.

why_choose_us.title: Straight with your insurer
why_choose_us.description: We document real damage and work directly with your adjuster so the claim reflects what actually happened. We are paid the same regardless of what your insurance pays, which is exactly why we can afford to be honest about it.

why_choose_us.title: Your yard, left clean
why_choose_us.description: Magnet sweep for nails, debris hauled, landscaping intact. Four separate customer reviews mention cleanup without being asked about it, which is the only kind of proof that counts.

financing.headline: Easy financing for the unexpected
financing.description: A roof rarely fails at a convenient moment. We offer financing options alongside every in-home estimate, so the conversation can be about the right repair rather than only the cheapest one. Ask your project manager when we walk the property.
